Thanks for the triage, Dev. I dug into RT-4382 and the Dedicated runtime logs. Quick findings:
- Around 2026-02-09T23:40:12Z we observe a streaming chunk boundary at token 2668 followed by a SessionReinit call triggered by the worker's kv cache shrink path. The shrink path was activated because memory pressure exceeded threshold for that pod (spike in concurrent long requests).
- The SessionReinit codepath currently reinitializes KV pointers but does not replay the prefix in streaming mode, which can lead to apparent context loss for follow-up queries if the client used streaming-only prefix transmission.
- There's no explicit exception; behavior is by-design but not ideal for live demo UX.

Short-term remediation we can do in ~3-6 hours: add a guard to the streaming flush so that when a SessionReinit is triggered we force a final prefix replay packet to the client and mark the session as "no-evict" for 30s. This is a config + tiny runtime change (no model recompile). Risk: minimal, but needs canary.

Medium-term (weeks): make KV shrink replay-safe and add observability flag that records when a replay occurred. Also evaluate adding an SDK-side transparent rejoin path so streaming clients automatically request missing prefix chunks.

For immediate customer-facing mitigations: Tactic (1) pin to fp16 variant — estimated 1-2 hours for confirmation and config flip; (2) enable "disable-stream-split" on their pool — ~2 hours to enable and test; (3) apply the runtime guard — ~3-6 hours plus canary.

I'll open an internal patch branch and a canary build. Dev — can you confirm if Edge Analytics can tolerate a 30-minute window for a canary deployment tomorrow morning PST? If so we'll schedule.

-Lukas
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime

1) We believe the root cause is a runtime KV-cache shrink triggering a SessionReinit during streaming. That means the server reinitializes session pointers which can drop in-memory prefix state for streaming-only clients. Not a model problem.

2) Short-term options we can enact before your renewal call:
   - Pin your model to the fp16 (non-quantized) build for the calls used in the demo (low friction).
   - Enable "disable-stream-split" on your Dedicated pool to avoid chunking that surfaces the shrink path.
   - We can schedule a brief canary deployment tomorrow 09:30 PST where runtime will roll a guard that forces prefix replay on SessionReinit (estimated 3-6 hours of engineering + 30m canary).

3) Please confirm which you prefer. If you want the canary, we need a 30-minute maintenance window tomorrow morning PST and permission to route a small percent of your traffic to the canary.
